name: cloudflux
description: Observe-only AWS cloud intelligence platform for small startup engineering teams.

scripts.dev:web: npm run build -w @cloudflux/contracts && npm run dev -w @cloudflux/web
scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w @cloudflux/contracts && npm run dev -w @cloudflux/api
scripts.build: npm run build -w @cloudflux/contracts && npm run build -w @cloudflux/api && npm run build -w @cloudflux/web
scripts.build:api: npm run build -w @cloudflux/contracts && npm run build -w @cloudflux/api
scripts.build:web: npm run build -w @cloudflux/contracts && npm run build -w @cloudflux/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @cloudflux/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @cloudflux/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @cloudflux/api && npm run typecheck -w @cloudflux/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @cloudflux/contracts && npm run lint -w @cloudflux/api && npm run lint -w @cloudflux/web
